entries.title: Start in camp
entries.body: Sign in with Google to create one gladiator. Choose a name, a look, a class, and starting attributes. You can move the camp camera and open a gladiator’s profile by selecting their character or name. Visitors can explore the camp without signing in.

entries.title: Your daily schedule
entries.body: Open Schedule, choose one activity for morning, afternoon, and evening, and save the whole day. Each slot lasts 80 minutes in real time, so a game day takes four hours. Your schedule repeats while you’re away. Edits apply to slots that haven’t started. Dungeons run in the afternoon and Arena bouts run in the evening.

entries.title: Stamina and Rest
entries.body: Activities use stamina. Rest restores it, and Schedule shows the expected recovery. If your gladiator cannot afford an activity, that slot becomes Rest. Heavy gear can raise stamina costs and make your gladiator less effective in combat. Check your load and capacity before planning a busy day.

entries.title: Training and leveling
entries.body:
Training earns attribute points up to your current level’s Training limit. You can complete two Training sessions per game day. A third becomes Rest. Expeditions and dungeons award XP, which raises your level and unlocks harder content and more gear. Spend earned points in My gladiator → Plan a build.

The XP bar sits under Stamina in My gladiator, and a thin XP line shows in the corner chip. A lighter segment shows what your next expedition could add, as an upper estimate (“up to”). If it says the expedition can level you up, finishing it may take you to the next level. The hint uses your scheduled expedition, or the best one available if none is scheduled.

entries.title: Classes and attributes
entries.body:
Berserkers favor Strength, Guardians favor Vitality and Endurance, and Duelists favor Agility and Precision. Any class can use any weapon it meets the requirements for.

Strength increases damage. Agility shortens the time between attacks and makes you harder to hit. Vitality raises maximum health. Endurance increases maximum stamina and gear capacity. Precision increases your chances to hit and to land a critical hit. Your class and the points in an active build are fixed.

My gladiator has Attributes and Stats blocks. Hover, focus, or tap an attribute or stat to read what it means and what changes it.

entries.title: Combat, dodge, and critical hits
entries.body:
Fights play automatically using your build. Offensive stance deals more damage and takes more damage. Defensive stance deals less and takes less. Balanced has no stance adjustment.

Attack speed is shown as the time between attacks. A shorter interval is faster. Your weapon sets the base interval, Agility shortens it, and overload slows it. Accuracy depends on your Precision and the defender’s Agility, so the chance of a dodge depends on the matchup. Critical is the chance per landed hit. A critical hit deals 50% more damage than a normal hit. Hover, focus, or tap a stat or attribute on a profile to see its help.

In the Arena and tournaments, renown armor counts 10% more and a renown weapon deals 10% more.

entries.title: Gear and builds
entries.body:
Equip a weapon, off-hand item, headgear, body armor, and footwear. A two-handed weapon uses both hands. Open Inventory and shops and select an item tile to check its details or use Wear. In My gladiator, hover, focus, or tap equipment to check its stats and weight, or use Plan a build to inspect replacement gear. The pending build shows when changes take effect. Raise Endurance or wear lighter gear if you are over capacity.

Identical items you are not using show as one tile with a count, such as x3. Each item is still its own copy: Wear and Discard work on one at a time. Type in the search box to find an item by name, and use Sort to order items, for example by level or name. Under Worn equipment in My gladiator, select a slot to see the gear you could put there and pick a replacement.

entries.title: Expeditions and rewards
entries.body: Pick an Expedition in Schedule. A successful Woodland Path run (level 1) pays 30 XP and 4 gold. Ruined Outpost (level 5) pays 75 XP and 10 gold. Mountain Pass (level 10) pays 150 XP and 18 gold. A successful run can also bring back salvage and gear. A defeat ends the trip without expedition rewards. Use the camp button to watch a trip live or replay it from the start.

entries.title: Party dungeons
entries.body:
Choose Dungeon in the afternoon. Wolf Den opens at level 3, Raider Stronghold at level 7, and Troll Hall at level 12. Entry costs 40 base stamina. The game automatically groups up to three players going to the same dungeon. Eligible Ludus Nimbus bots fill open seats after players, and hired fighters fill the rest.

Each run has three rooms and a boss. Health carries across fights. You keep the rewards for fights you took part in and your party won, even if the boss wins. Defeat the boss to open a chest. Higher-level gladiators can earn reduced rewards in easier dungeons. Watch the run live or replay it from Results.

entries.title: Arena and renown
entries.body:
Choose Arena for the evening to fight automatically in your league. Rated bouts against other players can raise or lower your rating. Renown is a separate currency earned through competition. Bouts against NPCs and Ludus Nimbus bots are unranked. Check Arena for recent opponents and Results → My bouts for your own record.

Practice fights: test your build against a dummy with stats you choose, or spar a copy of any gladiator. No stamina, no slot, no rating, nothing saved. Practice uses Arena rules, so renown gear counts 10% more.

entries.title: Tournaments and seasons
entries.body:
Tournaments run on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 18:40 UTC. Set your evening slot to Arena and enable automatic entry before the cutoff. A single-elimination bracket needs at least two entrants in your league. A formed bracket costs no stamina. If no bracket forms, the regular Arena costs still apply. Seasons last four weeks. Check the Tournaments and standings panels for prizes and timing.

Tournament bouts play in their own arena. The stands are split into Bronze, Silver, Gold and Champion sections, each crowd and banner in its league’s colours, and the ring on the sand is painted in all four.

You can open any league’s tournament and watch its bouts, even when your gladiator is not in it. It opens on your own league, marked “(yours)”. Pick another league to see its bracket and replays.

entries.title: Shops and Marketplace
entries.body:
Spend gold on standard gear and Marketplace purchases. Spend renown at the renown shop on Arena rewards. Sell salvage to a merchant for 4 gold each. Each shop shows its goods as a grid of icons: select one to see its card with the price, stats, and weight, then buy it. Use the filters for Weapons, Armor, and the gold or renown view, and search or sort as in Inventory. Click the Weaponsmith’s or Armorer’s stall in camp to open the shop on that filter. The Arena banner is in the Armorer’s Renown view. The Marketplace lists eligible player gear at fixed prices. Equipped, reserved, and bound items can’t be listed.

When you sell to a merchant, choose how many to sell, or press Max. Sold gear to a merchant by mistake? Press Buy back in Shops to see your last 10 gear sales of this game day, newest first, with the gold you got and the time left. Buy it back for exactly that gold and the same item returns with its level, rarity and stats. You can buy back until the next game day starts (every 4 hours); you need the gold and a free bag slot. Salvage cannot be bought back.

The Marketplace shows each listing as a row with a big item icon, level, rarity and stats, when it was listed, the time left, and what an NPC merchant would pay. View profile shows the seller’s card. Use the chips for Weapons, Armor or My listings, search by name, and sort by newest, price or level. To sell, open the Sell tab, choose an item and set your price: the card shows the market fee and what you receive. Fees, the 5-listing limit and the 7-day listing time are unchanged.

entries.title: Titles and profiles
entries.body:
My gladiator shows earned titles and progress toward locked titles. You can wear one title at a time or remove it for free. New titles can also appear in Notifications or with a result. Other players see your worn title with your name in camp, profiles, and fights.

A title you have just earned shows a small New mark in the titles menu until you have seen it there.

On another gladiator’s card, press ⇄ Compare with mine to set your gladiator’s stats beside theirs: Level, Health, Damage, Attack speed, Armor, Critical and Critical damage, then the five attributes. ▲ green on your side is better for you, ▼ red is worse, and the number is your value minus theirs. For Attack speed a shorter time is better. Equal values say same, and Level is only shown for context. It is for players with a gladiator, not on your own card. Nothing is sent.

Press 📜 History on any card to see that gladiator’s Arena bouts, tournament fights and expeditions, newest first, 20 at a time (Show more for older ones). Chips switch between the three lists. Press ▶ Watch to replay any bout, tournament fight or expedition still kept; replays last 7 days (tournament replays 7 days after the tournament ends), then the row stays, dimmed, with its result. Rewards stay private: on another card you see results only, and on your own you also see renown, rating change, prize and loot. A replay never shows loot.

entries.title: Results, replays, and messages
entries.body:
Open Results to review expeditions, dungeon runs, and fights. My bouts shows your Arena and tournament replays and lets you filter by wins or losses. You can pause or speed up a replay, choose when to reveal its result, and advance to the next bout. Notifications report your rewards and link to kept replays. Press the tick on a message to mark it read, or Mark all to clear every message; Notifications has a Mark all button too. Opening the Notifications tab still marks them as seen, and the button clears the dots. Messages carries patch notes, and Patch history lists earlier updates.

The Schedule tells you when a planned activity will not run. A part without enough stamina shows “Not enough stamina: your gladiator will rest instead”, with what it needs and what it will have: add a Rest before it or pick a cheaper activity. A third Training of a game day shows “Training limit: this becomes Rest (2 a game day)”. When the next part will not run, a Stamina notice in camp says so, with Open schedule, and a pop-up says so while your gladiator rests instead. Afterwards, Notifications and your Results line say it rested and why. After a lost expedition fight, your gladiator rests at the safe return point until the slot ends.

After 30 minutes away, returning to camp can show what your gladiator earned while you were gone: XP, level changes, gold, renown, fights, trips, training points, titles, loot, and rests that replaced planned activities. See all results opens Notifications. Got it marks the summarized notifications as seen, so the Messages count drops. It covers up to seven days and 150 results.

Found a bug, or have an idea? Open Messages and press Send feedback, or use Send in Settings under Help. Choose Bug, Idea, Balance or Other, write at least 10 characters, and press Send. You can send 5 a game day. Include game details adds the patch, screen, browser, device, window size and time (press “What is sent?” to see them). The team sees your gladiator’s name, and the answer comes to your messages with a green Team reply tag. A person sends every answer. Do not include passwords or personal details. My feedback in Messages shows whether the team has read or answered.

entries.title: Menus and settings
entries.body:
Long menus show one page at a time. The bar at the bottom says which page you are on (“Page 2 of 8”); use ‹ Back and Next ›, or press PageDown and PageUp. Each circle under it is a page: click or tap one to jump there, or on a phone press and hold a circle and slide along the row. Show sets rows per page: Fit, 10, 25 or 50, saved in this browser. My gladiator opens as five sections (Overview, Level and stamina, Attributes and stats, Worn equipment, History); Inventory and shops open as two. ← and → move between them.

On desktop, open Settings (⚙) to pin the menu and put it on the left, the right, or along the bottom. Your choice is saved in this browser only.

In Settings, under Names and titles, choose when names and titles show over the camp: Off, When zoomed in, or Always. Where names overlap, the nearer one stays and the others fade; point at a gladiator to bring its name back.

entries.title: Camp life
entries.body:
Click or tap an NPC in camp to hear a line from them, and again for their next one. Each has four. Brutus and Livia talk too; click their stalls to open the shops.

A resting gladiator lies on their bed with an eye cover and a small ZzZ floating above them, and takes off armor and helmet until they get up.
